name: webagent
description: Give your coding agent a cloud browser: run web tasks (research, forms, scrape, monitor) and test your app, with webagent's MCP tools, /webagent:run, /webagent:engines and /webagent:qa.

api_key.title: webagent API key
api_key.description: Key from the webagent dashboard (Keys, Create key; the member role is enough). Looks like wa_<region>_... Stored in your system keychain, never in a file.

api_url.title: webagent API URL
api_url.description: API origin without /mcp. Keep the default unless your team gave you another (beta: this is the staging host).
